issue.title: Meeting notes layer-2 enrichment: context packer plus configured command or SASE skill with logged corrections
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Add an optional "layer-2" enrichment pass for filed meeting notes. A context packer would gather the Event Task, its root note, and related tasks, then run a configured command or SASE skill. That pass proposes corrections, such as misheard names or product terms, and logs every correction it applies. The layer-1 normalizer stays structure-only and never rewrites a word. Enrichment would be a separate, explicitly invoked layer with its own provenance.

Source: the "Deferred" section of plan:202611/meeting_notes_event_refs.md (epic bob-cli-pw), whose requirement 6 says AI enrichment is a later, separate layer.
